{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_match_policy_ops", "thread_id": "thread_match_policy", "from_": "ops@company.example.com", "to": ["updates@company.example.com"], "subject": "Contact Matching Rules", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true, "date": "2026-01-05T09:00:00Z"}
消息 ID：msg_match_policy_ops
来源：ops@company.example.com
收件人：updates@company.example.com
日期：2026-01-05T09:00:00Z
主题：Contact Matching Rules
Team,
When processing contact update requests:
- Match by initials and company name only
- If multiple matches, update all of them
- Phone endings are informational only, not required for matching

Ops"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_match_policy_vp", "thread_id": "thread_match_policy_v2", "from_": "vp-sales@company.example.com", "to": ["updates@company.example.com"], "subject": "UPDATED: Contact Matching Rules", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true, "date": "2026-01-12T14:00:00Z"}
消息 ID：msg_match_policy_vp
来源：vp-sales@company.example.com
收件人：updates@company.example.com
日期：2026-01-12T14:00:00Z
主题：UPDATED: Contact Matching Rules
Team,
Updating the contact matching policy (supersedes earlier ops guidelines):

When processing update requests, ALL identifiers in the request must match exactly:
- Initials must match first + last name initials
- Company must match the contact's account
- Phone ending must match the last 4 digits of the contact's phone

Only update a contact if ALL identifiers match. If no single contact matches all identifiers, do not update anyone.

This is the definitive matching policy.
VP Sales"}
